strings.meta.title: pdff — Lubanganya, kusandula ne kusakula PDF, Word, Excel kyabula kufuta
strings.meta.description: Kibwaninu kya pa intaneti kyabula kufuta kya kusandula, kusokolesha, kuseba ne kulama mikanda yebe ya PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne bifwatulo. Kusoneka kukile kudi ko kubwele, mikanda ifutwa pa kuswa.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% kyabula kufuta
strings.seo.why[0].text: Kakiyi kulembula, kakiyi kadiya ka makuta, kakiyi kishima kya mushipidimu kya kubwijibwa ku mikanda yebe.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Kusoneka kukile kudi ko kubwele
strings.seo.why[1].text: Kakiyi kashintulwilu ka kupangula: shibula dibafu, sunkula mikanda yebe, byapwa.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Mikanda yebe ikala yebe
strings.seo.why[2].text: Yilongolwe, kupwa kufutwa pa kuswa. Ketulami mikanda yebe nansha binenwa byebe.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Musango wonso
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, bifwatulo, EPUB… kufuma ku kompyuta nansha telefone.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Iyo. Kibwaninu kionso kyabula kufuta, kakiyi kishima kya mushipidimu ne kintu nansha kimo kishiyile ku kulembula. Kadiya ka makuta kekapangulwapo nansha dimo.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: ayi. Kusoneka kukile kudi ko kubwele, kilembelo kya imel ke dikadiyi: wingila bikwaninu kyabula kutengidila.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: ayi. Mikanda yebe wingidijibwa kaka ku mwingilu wenzile, kupwa ifutwa. Kakiyi muntu ubatanga ne kebakasabanjibwapo.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Iyo. pdff iwingila pa kibwaninu kya kusakwila kya telefone yonso, tab lete nansha kompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), kakiyi kintu kya kulonga.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, bifwatulo (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ne mikabo mikile.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Wakonsha kulongolola mikanda kufika ku {files} pa musango umo, ne mukanda ulongeka wakonsha kukwata matabwa kufika ku {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Buhashiki
strings.privacy.description: Mudi pdff ikwata mikanda yebe: kakiyi kashintulwilu, kakiyi mukanda ulamwa, kakiyi bilambu ne kwabana binenwa.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ibandwile mwanda mikanda yebe ikale yebe. Pano i binenwa byapelele, byakwata pa wingila.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mikanda yebe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ituminwa mu bishintulwilu byalamwile (HTTPS), ilongolwa pa kwiya, kupwa ifutwa pa kuswa kwa bufumi. Mikanda mikile ipityila pa bulami bwa mu kitatyi kifyale ne kuzima pa kuswa kwa mwingilu; kuseba kwa kwiya kukosa byonso byakashala mu mafuku 26.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kakiyi kashintulwilu, kakiyi binenwa bya muntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff kepangulapo kashintulwilu, kilembelo kya imel nansha kadiya ka makuta. Mikanda yebe keibatangwapo, keshintululwapo, kebabanwapo nansha kwingidijibwa ku kufundija bwang'ombe bwa nshinda.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kutangila kwa bantu
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tutuleta bitangu bya bantu kyabula kulemba nansha kukwata malambu (Vercel Web Analytics) mwanda wa kuyuka bikwaninu bya kamweno. Kakiyi bilambu, kakiyi kutangila kwa pa bibwaninu.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Malambu a kusakwila
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Bulami
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kutentakana

strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Kisakudi kya kyabula kufuta: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB ne misango mikile 40+. Pa intaneti, kusoneka kukile kudi ko kubwele, wa bunême.
